messages:
Samir Patel: FYI — urgent support->CS handoff. Trial account (HorizonApps) repeatedly hitting the welcome flow at step 3, users are dropped and not receiving the invite email. Customer on a one-week trial, kickoff call scheduled tomorrow at 10am PT. High renewal risk if we don't fix ASAP. Pls advise owners and comms plan. :warning:
Maria Gomez: Thanks Samir — can you paste the error/user trace and the last successful step? Also need to know whether this is a mass failure or single-tenant.
Samir Patel: Pasted logs below from support session (sanitized):
```
2024-11-12T18:12:03Z ERROR invite-service timeout for tenant horizonapps: POST /v1/invite 504
2024-11-12T18:12:03Z WARN smtp send failed: connection reset
```
This looks like SMTP relay flakiness. Happened for 4 distinct user emails in the last hour. Not platform-wide.
June Park: @Maria @Liam I can take customer comms and run the onboarding call if we promise a mitigation within 4 hours. I'll need a brief we can share and an interim workaround (manual invites).
Liam O'Connor: I'll triage the relay. Quick ask: Samir, can you confirm which SMTP provider they have configured (headers show relay=mailq-us-east.example)? If it's our relay, we should switch them to fallback via customer SMTP or send manual invites.
Samir Patel: Confirmed — customer is using our hosted relay (region us-east-1). Ticket created: INC-76891. OpsBot created the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-76891 
OpsBot: Incident INC-76891 created by Samir Patel — Priority: P1 (trial at renewal risk) — Assignees: Liam O'Connor; Ops engineering notified.
Maria Gomez: Proposed comms plan: 1) June to call customer at 10am PT and apologize + give ETA. 2) Same-day manual invites from support (Samir) as temporary fix. 3) Engineering (Liam) to attempt relay failover to secondary host and confirm by 14:00 PT. 4) Follow-up email template w/ root cause + steps + credits for friction. Who owns the follow-up?
June Park: I’ll own the live call and send the follow-up email. Draft template below — please edit quickly: "Apologies for the interruption. We're sending manual invites now and our engineers are failing over the relay. We'll confirm when automatic invites are restored and provide a short postmortem."
Liam O'Connor: I've started failover now. I will update INC-76891 with timestamps. If failover fails, plan B is to flip customer to SMTP auth using their own provider (they indicated they can support this).
Samir Patel: Manual invites are queued; I’ll DM the list to June. Also flagging billing — trial extension to cover lost onboarding time? Maria, can you approve a 7-day trial extension if needed?
Maria Gomez: Approved 7-day extension if we can’t confirm full restore by EOD. June, please capture customer sentiment on the call and add to the ticket.
June Park: On the call now — customer is frustrated but receptive. They asked for a single point of contact (SPoC). I'll be the SPoC and will post a summary here after the call. :phone:
Liam O'Connor: Failover succeeded — relay switched to secondary, invites are flowing. INC-76891 updated. Estimated full restore time: 15 minutes.
Samir Patel: Confirmed — two users received invites. I'll continue sending manual invites for the remaining users while we monitor.
Maria Gomez: Great. Action items: June = SPoC + call + follow-up email; Liam = incident updates and postmortem; Samir = manual invites + ticket notes; Maria = approve extension if needed + draft credits. Re-open if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
June Park: Summary for the record (to paste to customer): "We encountered a transient issue with our hosted email relay that interrupted automated invites. We’ve failed over to a secondary relay, sent manual invites, and will follow up with a short postmortem and a 7-day trial extension if needed. Point of contact: June Park (june@redwood.com)."
Samir Patel: Thanks team — closing loop with support and customer. Leaving ticket in monitoring for 24h.
Maria Gomez: Thanks all — please add any notes on the customer health dashboard and tag renewal manager if sentiment is negative.
OpsBot: INC-76891 status -> Monitoring.
